description: GPU inference specialist workstation (RTX 5090, 32GB VRAM, 192GB RAM). Primary local-lane compute for coding (KiloCode GLM) and voice studio rooms. Heavy inference stays local via Ollama; cloud fallback follows env.shared order (ollama_cloud first).
notes: Ollama tags byte-verified live on the node (pmoves-5090 :11434, 2026-10-25): qwen3-coder:30b, gpt-oss:20b, qwen3.5:9b, gemma3:12b, mistral-small3.2:24b, hermes3:8b; embeds nomic-embed-text (latest + v1.5), Qwen3-Embedding-4B Q8_0. Use only tags that exist in the node registry (see #3402: 3 of 4 suit tags were 404).
Alternate local chat lane: gpt-oss:20b. Embedding lane: nomic-embed-text:latest.
pmoves_profile uses the canonical id desktop-9950xd; the workstation_5090 yaml is a deprecated alias.
Room stage stays rehearsal as the room manifests define it; flip via the room manifest, not this profile.
A0 presets for this node are generator-owned: make a0-model-sync (registry = config authority); hand presets survive per #3396 hybrid contract.
The Hermes profile itself must be created on the node (hermes profile use PMOVES-HERMES-5090); this launcher profile declares and seeds it.
Cloud fallback follows env.shared order: ollama_cloud first. No API-burn lanes by default.
Profile is local-only; never commit secret values.
